believe.headline: Five claims we will defend in public
believe.body: Every product decision Davion makes traces back to one of these. If you read them and disagree, we're probably not the right vendor, and that's a useful thing to learn early.
believe.c01t: Sovereignty is where the work happens
believe.c01b: Regulatory residency is not sovereignty. Hosted AI with a European postcode is not sovereignty. Sovereignty is determined by where the data lives, where the weights are stored, and where the inference runs. Davion runs where the work runs.
believe.c02t: A decision is only defensible when it can be reconstructed
believe.c02b: AI without an audit trail is not AI an institution can use. Every output Davion produces points back to the data it was made on, the policy it applied, and the version of the model that produced it. If a regulator asks "why", the platform has an answer.
believe.c03t: The hard cases are not edge cases
believe.c03b: Air-gapped. On-prem. Inside a perimeter you control. These are not exceptions to the category, they are the operational reality of every institution where decisions actually matter. We design for the hard case first; the easier deployments are downstream.
believe.c04b: Davion is composable end to end and replaceable end to end. Ingestion, ontology, analytics, agentic layer, action, each is replaceable. We intend to be a vendor you can leave. That is how vendors who deserve to stay get to stay.
believe.c05t: The operator runs the system. We do not run the decisions.
believe.c05b: Davion is a platform, not an autonomous agent. The decisions belong to the people accountable for them: the analyst, the compliance officer, the operator, the commander. The platform proposes, cites its sources, and waits for approval. We do not move money. We do not move people. We do not move troops.

layers.headline: Five layers. One spine. Designed to be governed

l1.title: Data integration & preparation
l1.body: Pull every relevant signal, structured, unstructured, real-time, archival, through a single governed pipeline. Native connectors, schema-on-read or schema-on-write, lineage tracked from source. Nothing is collected blindly. Nothing is collected outside policy.

l2.title: Semantic model of your domain
l2.body: Entities, events, and relationships modeled to your domain, not a generic schema. The ontology becomes the shared vocabulary across analysts, engineers, and operators. Queries and AI reason against it, not against raw tables.

l3.title: Analytics, knowledge graphs, weak-signal detection
l3.body: Run the analytic load where the data lives. Knowledge graphs surface relationships flat queries miss. Statistical and ML methods detect the patterns, and the weak signals that precede them.

l4.title: AI copilot with traceability
l4.body: An agentic copilot that argues from the ontology, cites the data, and shows its work. Every recommendation is traceable to its source. Hallucinations do not survive contact with auditable evidence.

l5.title: Operational decisioning & workflow
l5.body: Decisions only matter when they reach the operator and the system. Workflows, dispatch, case management, and write-back to systems of record are embedded, so AlpOS does not stop at insight.

audit.headline: Who. What. When. Why.
audit.body: Every action on the platform is captured to a tamper-evident, customer-owned audit log. Designed for the regulator, the after-action, and the internal review board.
audit.whoBody: Every operator, every analyst, every system identity is named, no anonymous actions.
audit.whatBody: The action, the query, the input, the AI output, the workflow transition, captured in full.
audit.whenBody: Trusted timestamps, write-once log, tamper-evident chain.
audit.whyBody: Purpose tags carry through every action, supporting after-action review and regulatory inquiry.

standards.headline: Engineered to the standards your auditors already use.
standards.body: Davion designs to the frameworks your security team and regulators already operate by. Where formal certification applies, we document the scope and the evidence per engagement.
standards.isoBody: Information security management system aligned to the platform and to operator practice.
standards.socBody: Security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy, engineered for; audited where applicable.
standards.nis2Body: Critical-infrastructure cyber regulation as a deployment baseline in EU jurisdictions.
standards.gdprBody: Lawful basis, data-subject rights, and DPA-ready by design.
standards.sectorBody: Defense, financial-services, healthcare, and public-sector regimes addressed per engagement.

ai.headline: Sovereign inference. Cited outputs. Refusal when warranted.
ai.body: AI inside AlpOS is governed the same way every other layer is, with provenance, citation, audit, and the right to refuse. We do not ship AI that the institution cannot defend.
ai.sovInfBody: Models run inside your perimeter. No training data, no gradients, no outputs cross into Davion or any vendor without explicit policy.
ai.provenBody: Every model used, every version, every input, recorded against every output.
ai.citationBody: Outputs cite their source data. An AI conclusion you cannot trace is one you cannot defend.
ai.refusalBody: When confidence is low or evidence is missing, the system says so. Defensible over confident.
ai.hitlBody: Consequential actions require a named operator. The AI does not act unilaterally.
ai.noCovertBody: Customer data is never used to train shared models without explicit, written consent.

lifecycle.headline: Ingest. Process. Use. Retain. Delete.
lifecycle.body: The data lifecycle is governed end to end. Policy enforced at the boundary, lineage tracked through transformation, retention bounded by contract, deletion provable on request.
lifecycle.l1Body: Data enters under policy, sources, purposes, and retention declared at the source.
lifecycle.l2Body: Lineage tracked through transforms, joins, and enrichments. Every derived datum is traceable to its origin.
lifecycle.l3Body: Access governed by RBAC + ABAC. Queries logged. AI outputs cited.
lifecycle.l4Body: Retention policy enforced per-source, per-purpose. Customer-defined, contractually bound.
lifecycle.l5Body: Right-to-erasure honored. Cryptographic deletion where required. Provable, not just claimed.

engage.headline: Bring your security team to the table.
engage.body: We answer security questionnaires in full, run technical deep-dives against your environment, and provide the evidence your audit team will ask for, before you commit.

meta.title: Responsible AI
meta.description: Davion's commitments on data sovereignty, decision-trace lineage, human-in-the-loop, and adversarial robustness. The principles AlpOS is engineered against.
meta.ogDescription: Sovereignty, lineage, human-in-the-loop, robustness. The principles AlpOS is engineered against.

rai.headline: Principles AlpOS is engineered against
rai.intro: Davion publishes its responsible-AI commitments as engineering claims, not aspirations. Where a claim is fully implemented, it says so. Where a claim is targeted but not yet certified, it says engineered to. Where work is in progress, it says in progress for, with a date. Honesty is the precondition for trust.
rai.c1Body: AlpOS deploys inside the customer's perimeter, on-prem, air-gapped, or in a sovereign cloud bound by contract. Customer data, weights, and audit logs stay where the customer specifies. We do not train central foundation models on customer data; what runs inside a customer deployment stays in that deployment.
rai.c2Body: Every output AlpOS produces points back to the data it was made on, the policy it applied, and the version of the model that produced it. A regulator or internal auditor can reconstruct the decision from raw source to final action. This is engineered into the spine, not bolted on.
rai.c3Body: AlpOS is a platform, not an autonomous agent. It proposes, cites its sources, and waits for approval. The platform does not move money, does not move people, does not move troops. The decisions belong to the operators accountable for them, analyst, compliance officer, commander.
rai.c4Body: Models that operate against adversarial inputs (OSINT, intelligence, fraud, cybersecurity) are evaluated against red-team scenarios and prompt-injection attacks before deployment. Customer deployments include evaluation harnesses so model behaviour can be regression-tested as data evolves.
rai.c5Body: A regulator wants a different kind of explanation than an analyst. AlpOS surfaces explanations in the language and granularity each audience needs: citations and source passages for analysts; policy-trace and model-version for regulators; natural-language rationales for operators.
rai.c6Title: Bias monitoring against the customer's population
rai.c6Body: No platform-wide "fairness metric" survives every domain. Customer deployments include per-population disparity monitoring against the customer's own protected-attribute definitions, with thresholds reviewable by the customer's ethics or compliance function.
rai.c7Title: No third-party model API calls without explicit consent
rai.c7Body: AlpOS deployments run against models hosted inside the customer's perimeter by default. If a deployment integrates a hosted model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), it is a per-engagement decision documented in the deployment architecture and the DPA, never a hidden default.
rai.c8Body: Modular replaces lock-in. Davion is composable end to end and replaceable end to end. If a customer terminates the engagement, the data, the weights, the audit log, and the ontology are theirs. We will be a vendor you can leave.
rai.alignIntro: Each row uses honest status language: Engineered to means the platform is designed against the framework; In progress for means we are working toward formal certification with a target date; Achieved would mean we hold a current certificate (none yet).

evp.headline: Five things we promise
evp.p1: Consequential problems. The customers are institutions where decisions actually matter. The bugs you fix make the news for the right reasons; the ones you ship matter for the wrong ones.
evp.p2: Small team for a long time. We hire deliberately. You will know everyone. You will be deeply load-bearing on something. You will not get diluted into a process org.
evp.p3: Operator culture. Engineers go on-site. Field roles read the code. We do not have a wall between "build" and "deploy."
evp.p4: Real equity. Meaningful early-stage grants with founder-friendly vesting. We are building a company with real customers, not a markup carousel.
evp.p5: Honest hiring. Paid work sessions instead of unpaid take-homes. Real conversations instead of trick questions. Decisions inside a week.

process.p1Body: A 30-minute call with the founder or a hiring lead. We discuss the mission, the role, your work, and whether the chemistry is there to keep going. No pitch deck. No homework.
process.p2Body: A real working session against a real Davion problem, usually 2-4 hours, paid. You see how we think; we see how you think. We do not believe in unpaid take-homes.
process.p3Body: Reference conversations on both sides. Offer or honest decline within a week of the work session. We respect your time.
